    <button class="provider-pill" onclick="setProviderFilter('GITS', this)">GITS Gyeonggi (3.2K)</button>
    <button class="provider-pill" onclick="setProviderFilter('SPATIC', this)">Seoul SPATIC (1.0K)</button>
    <button class="provider-pill" onclick="setProviderFilter('CITY_ITS', this)">Kota ITS (Incheon/Busan/dll)</button>
    <button class="provider-pill" onclick="setProviderFilter('SISUL', this)">Seoul SISUL (Naver)</button>

  <!-- Video Player Modal -->
  <div class="player-modal" id="playerModal">
    <div class="player-header">
      <div class="player-title" id="camTitle">Live CCTV</div>
      <button class="player-close" onclick="closePlayer()">&times;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="video-container">
      
      <video id="cctvVideo" controls autoplay playsinline muted></video>
    </div>
    <div class="player-meta">
      <span>Sumber: <span class="player-source" id="camSource">-</span></span>
      <span id="playerStatus">🟢 Siap Streaming</span>
    </div>

  <script>
    let map = null;
    let clusterer = null;
    let currentHls = null;
    let activeResolveUrl = null;
    let currentProviderFilter = 'ALL';
    const loadedCamIds = new Set();

    function setProviderFilter(prov, btn) {
      if (currentProviderFilter === prov) return;
      currentProviderFilter = prov;
      document.querySelectorAll('.provider-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

      // Clear existing markers & reload
      if (clusterer) clusterer.clearLayers();
      loadedCamIds.clear();
      scheduleSpatialFetch();
    }

    function init() {
      if (typeof L === 'undefined' || typeof L.map === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(init, 100);
        return;
      }
      if (map) return;

      map = L.map('map', {
        center: [37.5665, 126.9780],
        zoom: 11,
        minZoom: 5,
        maxZoom: 20,
        zoomControl: false,
        zoomSnap: 0.5,
        zoomDelta: 0.5,
        wheelPxPerZoomLevel: 60
      });

      L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomleft' }).addTo(map);

      // 1. Google Maps Jalan Raya & Label Hangul (Default Super Akurat & Mulus)
      const googleRoads = L.tileLayer('https://mt{s}.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}', {
        maxZoom: 20,
        subdomains: ['0', '1', '2', '3'],
        attribution: '&copy; Google Maps'
      });

      // 2. Google Satellite Hybrid (Foto Udara + Garis Jalan)
      const googleHybrid = L.tileLayer('https://mt{s}.google.com/vt/lyrs=y&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}', {
        maxZoom: 20,
        subdomains: ['0', '1', '2', '3'],
        attribution: '&copy; Google Satellite'
      });

      // 3. Esri World Street Map (Navigasi Bersih)
      const esriStreet = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: 'Tiles &copy; Esri'
      });

      // 4. Carto Voyager (Gaya Minimalis Modern)
      const cartoVoyager = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
        maxZoom: 20,
        subdomains: 'abcd',
        attribution: '&copy; CartoDB'
      });

      // Set default layer
      googleRoads.addTo(map);

      // Layer Control (Switcher)
      L.control.layers({
        '🗺️ Google Maps (Akurat)': googleRoads,
        '🛰️ Satelit Hybrid': googleHybrid,
        '🎨 Carto Voyager': cartoVoyager,
        '🏛️ Esri Street': esriStreet
      }, null, { position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);

      clusterer = L.markerClusterGroup({
        maxClusterRadius: 45,
        disableClusteringAtZoom: 15,
        spiderfyOnMaxZoom: true,
        chunkedLoading: true,
        chunkInterval: 100,
        chunkDelay: 20
      });
      map.addLayer(clusterer);

      setTimeout(() => { if (map) map.invalidateSize(); }, 200);
      setTimeout(() => { if (map) map.invalidateSize(); }, 800);
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (map) map.invalidateSize(); });

      // Dynamic Viewport Loading (Spatial Bounding Box)
      map.on('moveend', scheduleSpatialFetch);
      scheduleSpatialFetch();
    }

    let spatialDebounceTimer = null;
    function scheduleSpatialFetch() {
      clearTimeout(spatialDebounceTimer);
      spatialDebounceTimer = setTimeout(loadSpatialViewportCams, 250);
    }

    function loadSpatialViewportCams() {
      if (!map) return;
      const b = map.getBounds();
      const indicator = document.getElementById('loadingIndicator');
      if (indicator) indicator.style.display = 'flex';
      
      const q = '/api/cams-spatial?min_lat=' + b.getSouth().toFixed(4) +
                '&max_lat=' + b.getNorth().toFixed(4) +
                '&min_lng=' + b.getWest().toFixed(4) +
                '&max_lng=' + b.getEast().toFixed(4) +
                '&limit=1500' +
                '&provider=' + encodeURIComponent(currentProviderFilter);
      
      fetch(q)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(cams => {
          renderCameras(cams);
          if (indicator) indicator.style.display = 'none';
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (indicator) indicator.style.display = 'none';
        });
    }

    function renderCameras(cams) {
      if (!cams || !cams.length) return;
      const newMarkers = [];
      const camIcon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'custom-cam-pin',
        html: '<div style="background:#0284c7; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #fff; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(2,132,199,0.8); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:11px;">🎥</div>',
        iconSize: [22, 22],
        iconAnchor: [11, 11]
      });

      cams.forEach(c => {
        const [id, name, lat, lng, source, streamUrl] = c;
        if (!loadedCamIds.has(id)) {
          loadedCamIds.add(id);
          const marker = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon: camIcon, title: name });
          marker.bindTooltip('<b>' + name + '</b><br><span style="color:#0284c7;font-size:10px;">🔴 LIVE STREAM</span>', { direction: 'top', offset: [0, -10] });
          marker.on('click', () => playCam(name, source, streamUrl, id));
          newMarkers.push(marker);
        }
      });

      if (newMarkers.length > 0 && clusterer) {
        clusterer.addLayers(newMarkers);
      }
    }

    function playCam(name, source, streamUrl, id) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('playerModal');
      const title = document.getElementById('camTitle');
      const srcEl = document.getElementById('camSource');
      const video = document.getElementById('cctvVideo');
      const status = document.getElementById('playerStatus');

      title.textContent = name;
      srcEl.textContent = source;
      status.textContent = '🔄 Menghubungkan Stream...';
      modal.style.display = 'flex';
      

      if (currentHls) {
        currentHls.destroy();
        currentHls = null;
      }

      // Check if this is KBS Disaster
      if (source === 'KBS_DISASTER' || source === 'KBS' || streamUrl.indexOf('loomex.net') !== -1) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Token Live KBS...';
        let cctvid = '';
        if (id && id.indexOf('KBS_') !== -1) {
          cctvid = id.replace('KBS_', '');
        } else if (streamUrl.indexOf('_definst_/') !== -1) {
          const rest = streamUrl.split('_definst_/')[1];
          cctvid = rest.split('_')[0];
        }

        if (cctvid) {
          fetch('/api/kbs-resolve?id=' + encodeURIComponent(cctvid))
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
              if (data.proxyUrl) {
                status.textContent = '🟢 Token KBS Aktif, Memutar Stream...';
                startPlayer(data.proxyUrl, false);
              } else {
                status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'KBS Offline');
              }
            })
            .catch(err => {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal handshake KBS: ' + err.message;
            });
          return;
        }
      }

      // Check if this is a dynamic Z3 Highway Camera
      // Check if this is GITS (Gyeonggi Province)
      if (source === 'GITS_GYEONGGI' || source === 'GITS' || streamUrl.includes('gitsview.gg.go.kr')) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Token Live Gyeonggi (GITS)...';
        let cctvid = '';
        const gitsMarker = 'gitsview.gg.go.kr/';
        const gIdx = streamUrl.indexOf(gitsMarker);
        if (gIdx !== -1) {
          const rest = streamUrl.slice(gIdx + gitsMarker.length);
          cctvid = rest.split('/')[0];
        }

        if (cctvid) {
          fetch('/api/gits-resolve?id=' + encodeURIComponent(cctvid))
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
              if (data.streamUrl) {
                status.textContent = '🟢 Token GITS Aktif, Memutar Stream...';
                const target = data.streamUrl.startsWith('http://') ? 'https://' + data.streamUrl.slice(7) : data.streamUrl;
                startPlayer(target, data.type === 'mp4');
              } else {
                status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'GITS Offline / Sleep');
              }
            })
            .catch(err => {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal handshake GITS: ' + err.message;
            });
          return;
        }
      }

      if (streamUrl.includes('/api/jeju-resolve')) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Jalur Pipa !hls Jeju (Kakao Core Realtime)...';
        fetch(streamUrl)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            const playTarget = data.proxyUrl || data.url;
            if (playTarget) {
              const isMp4 = data.type === "video/mp4" || playTarget.includes(".mp4");
              status.textContent = isMp4 ? '🟢 Live Video Jeju (MP4)' : '🟢 Stream Jeju Terhubung (HLS 30FPS Realtime)';
              startPlayer(playTarget, isMp4, streamUrl);
            } else {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'CCTV Jeju sedang dalam pemeliharaan');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal memuat stream Jeju: ' + err.message;
          });
        return;
      }

      if (streamUrl.includes('/api/naver-resolve?key=')) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Jalur Naver KT ICT Realtime...';
        fetch(streamUrl)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            const playTarget = data.proxyUrl || data.url;
            if (playTarget) {
              const isMp4 = data.type === 'video/mp4' || playTarget.includes('.mp4');
              status.textContent = '🟢 Live Seoul SISUL (HLS 30FPS Realtime)';
              startPlayer(playTarget, isMp4, streamUrl);
            } else {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'Offline / Pemeliharaan Kamera (Naver)');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal stream Naver: ' + err.message;
          });
        return;
      }

      if (streamUrl.includes('/api/z3-resolve?key=')) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Jalur Pipa !hls (Kakao Core Realtime)...';
        fetch(streamUrl)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            const playTarget = data.proxyUrl || data.url;
            if (playTarget) {
              const isMp4 = data.type === "video/mp4" || playTarget.includes(".mp4");
              status.textContent = isMp4 ? '🟢 Live Highway Z3 (MP4)' : '🟢 Live Highway Z3 (HLS 30FPS Realtime)';
              startPlayer(playTarget, isMp4, streamUrl);
            } else {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'Kamera Z3 sedang offline');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal memuat Z3: ' + err.message;
          });
        return;
      }

      if (streamUrl.startsWith('Z3:')) {
        status.textContent = '🔄 Handshake Token Sesi Z3...';
        const parts = streamUrl.split(':');
        const cctvip = parts[1];
        const query = parts.slice(2).join(':');

        fetch('/api/z3-resolve?cctvip=' + encodeURIComponent(cctvip) + '&query=' + encodeURIComponent(query))
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.proxyUrl) {
              status.textContent = '🟢 Token Aktif, Memutar Stream...';
              startPlayer(data.proxyUrl, false);
            } else {
              status.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.error || 'Gagal handshake Z3');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            status.textContent = '⚠️ Gagal menghubungi Z3 Resolver';
          });
        return;
      }

      let playUrl = '/proxy?url=' + encodeURIComponent(streamUrl);
      const isMp4 = streamUrl.includes('gitsview.gg.go.kr') || streamUrl.endsWith('.mp4');
      startPlayer(playUrl, isMp4);
    }

    function startPlayer(playUrl, isMp4, resolveUrl) {
      const video = document.getElementById('cctvVideo');
      const status = document.getElementById('playerStatus');

      if (resolveUrl) {
        activeResolveUrl = resolveUrl;
      }

      if (isMp4) {
        video.src = playUrl;
        video.onloadeddata = () => {
          status.textContent = '🟢 Live Streaming (Continuous HD)';
        };

        // AUTO-SEAMLESS CONTINUOUS LOOP (Anti-30 Detik Mentok)
        video.onended = () => {
          if (activeResolveUrl) {
            status.textContent = '🔄 Memuat segmen live terkini...';
            const refreshUrl = activeResolveUrl + (activeResolveUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + '_t=' + Date.now();
            fetch(refreshUrl)
              .then(res => res.json())
              .then(data => {
                const nextUrl = data.url || data.vodUrl || data.proxyUrl;
                if (nextUrl) {
                  video.src = nextUrl;
                  video.play().catch(() => {});
                  status.textContent = '🟢 Live Streaming Aktif (Non-Stop)';
                }
              })
              .catch(() => {
                video.currentTime = 0;
                video.play().catch(() => {});
              });
          } else {
            video.currentTime = 0;
            video.play().catch(() => {});
          }
        };

        video.onerror = () => {
          if (!video.src.includes('/proxy?url=')) {
            console.log('[MP4] Retrying via proxy bridge...');
            video.src = '/proxy?url=' + encodeURIComponent(playUrl);
            video.play().catch(() => {});
          } else {
            status.textContent = '⚠️ Stream sedang offline/sibuk';
          }
        };
        video.play().catch(() => {});
      } else if (Hls.isSupported()) {
        currentHls = new Hls({
          enableWorker: true,
          lowLatencyMode: true,
          liveSyncDurationCount: 1,
          liveMaxLatencyDurationCount: 3,
          maxBufferLength: 10,
          maxMaxBufferLength: 20,
          backBufferLength: 6,
          startFragPrefetch: true,
          manifestLoadingTimeOut: 12000,
          manifestLoadingMaxRetry: 5,
          manifestLoadingRetryDelay: 500,
          levelLoadingTimeOut: 12000,
          levelLoadingMaxRetry: 5,
          levelLoadingRetryDelay: 500,
          fragLoadingTimeOut: 15000,
          fragLoadingMaxRetry: 5,
          fragLoadingRetryDelay: 500
        });
        currentHls.loadSource(playUrl);
        currentHls.attachMedia(video);
        video.onplaying = () => {
          
        };
        video.onwaiting = () => {
          
        };
        
        currentHls.on(Hls.Events.FRAG_LOADING, () => {
          if (!video.currentTime) status.textContent = '🔄 Mengunduh potongan live stream...';
        });
        currentHls.on(Hls.Events.FRAG_LOADED, () => {
          if (!video.currentTime) status.textContent = '🟢 Buffer diterima, memulai pemutaran...';
        });
        currentHls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, () => {
          video.play().catch(() => {});
          status.textContent = '🟢 Live Streaming (HLS)';
        });
        video.onplaying = () => {
          status.textContent = '🟢 Live Streaming Aktif';
        };
        video.onwaiting = () => {
          status.textContent = '🔄 Memuat buffer siaran live...';
        };
        
        let isRecovering = false;
        currentHls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, (event, data) => {
          if (data.fatal) {
            status.textContent = '🔄 Auto-Reconnecting Session...';
            if (data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR) {
              console.log('[HLS] Network error, recovering load...');
              currentHls.startLoad();
            } else if (data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR) {
              console.log('[HLS] Media error, attempting buffer recovery...');
              currentHls.recoverMediaError();
            } else if (!isRecovering) {
              isRecovering = true;
              console.log('[HLS] Fatal session expired, refreshing master token...');
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (currentHls) {
                  currentHls.destroy();
                  currentHls = null;
                }
                if (activeResolveUrl) {
                  const refUrl = activeResolveUrl + (activeResolveUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + '_t=' + Date.now();
                  fetch(refUrl)
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(d => {
                      const newTarget = d.proxyUrl || d.url;
                      if (newTarget) startPlayer(newTarget, d.type === 'video/mp4', activeResolveUrl);
                    })
                    .catch(() => {
                      startPlayer(playUrl, false, activeResolveUrl);
                    });
                } else {
                  startPlayer(playUrl, false);
                }
              }, 1000);
            }
          }
        });
      } else {
        video.src = playUrl;
        video.play().catch(() => {});
        status.textContent = '🟢 Native Stream';
      }
    }

    function closePlayer() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('playerModal');
      const video = document.getElementById('cctvVideo');
      
      modal.style.display = 'none';
      video.pause();
      video.onended = null;
      activeResolveUrl = null;
      if (currentHls) {
        currentHls.destroy();
        currentHls = null;
      }
    }

    function flyToCity(lat, lng, zoom, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.city-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      if (map) {
        map.flyTo([lat, lng], zoom, { duration: 1.2 });
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    window.addEventListener('load', init);
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;

  return html;
}

async function handleProxy(request, url, ctx) {
  let targetUrl = url.searchParams.get("url");
  if (!targetUrl) return new Response("Missing url param", { status: 400 });

  // GITS (Gyeonggi) streams run on Nimble server with Geo/IP ACL that blocks Cloudflare edge egress
  // Route GITS streams seamlessly through the dedicated Korea media proxy
  
  // Dedicated bridge for raw IP (Incheon 61.40.94.13, Jeju 123.140.197.51) and Geo-blocked river networks (HRFCO, Yeongsan)
  // Route through dedicated Oracle proxy bridge and rewrite chunklists to /proxy?url=
  if (targetUrl.includes("61.40.94.13") || targetUrl.includes("hrfco.go.kr") || targetUrl.includes("yeongsanriver.go.kr") || targetUrl.includes("123.140.197.51")) {
    const upstreamUrl = "https://ciro-cctv-proxy.fly.dev/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(targetUrl);
    try {
      const bridgeHeaders = {
        "User-Agent": request.headers.get("User-Agent") || "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
        "Accept": "*/*"
      };
      if (targetUrl.includes("hrfco.go.kr") || targetUrl.includes("yeongsanriver.go.kr")) {
        bridgeHeaders["Referer"] = "https://hrfco.go.kr/sumun/cctvPopup.do";
        bridgeHeaders["Origin"] = "https://hrfco.go.kr";
      }
      const resp = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
        method: request.method,
        headers: bridgeHeaders
      });
      const contentType = resp.headers.get("content-type") || "";
      const isM3u8 = targetUrl.includes(".m3u8") || contentType.includes("mpegurl");

      if (isM3u8 && resp.ok) {
        let text = await resp.text();
        text = text.replaceAll("https://ciro-cctv-proxy.fly.dev/proxy?url=", "/proxy?url=");
        return new Response(text, {
          status: resp.status,
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": contentType || "application/vnd.apple.mpegurl",
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
            "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=2"
          }
        });
      }

      const newHeaders = new Headers(resp.headers);
      newHeaders.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
      return new Response(resp.body, {
        status: resp.status,
        headers: newHeaders
      });
    } catch (e) {
      return new Response("Ciro proxy relay error: " + e.message, { status: 502 });
    }
  }

  if (targetUrl.includes("gitsview.gg.go.kr")) {
    const upstreamUrl = "https://ciro-cctv-proxy.fly.dev/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(targetUrl);
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
        method: request.method,
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": request.headers.get("User-Agent") || "Mozilla/5.0",
          "Range": request.headers.get("Range") || "",
          "Accept": "*/*"
        }
      });
      const newHeaders = new Headers(resp.headers);
      newHeaders.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
      newHeaders.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "*");
      newHeaders.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Length, Content-Type, Range");
      return new Response(resp.body, {
        status: resp.status,
        headers: newHeaders
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // Fallback to direct fetch if upstream proxy fails
    }
  }

  const reqHeaders = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Accept": "*/*",
    "Accept-Language": "ko-KR,ko;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7"
  };

  if (targetUrl.includes("ktict.co.kr") || targetUrl.includes("daumcdn.net")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://map.kakao.com/";
    reqHeaders["Origin"] = "https://map.kakao.com";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("utic.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://www.utic.go.kr/";
    reqHeaders["Origin"] = "https://www.utic.go.kr";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("its.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://www.its.go.kr/";
    reqHeaders["Origin"] = "https://www.its.go.kr";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("daegu.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://carcctv.daegu.go.kr/";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("busan.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://its.busan.go.kr/";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("spatic.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://spatic.go.kr/";
  }
  else if (targetUrl.includes("gjtic.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "http://gjtic.go.kr/";
    reqHeaders["Origin"] = "http://gjtic.go.kr";
  }

  if (targetUrl.includes("gitsview.gg.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://gits.gg.go.kr/";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("loomex.net") || targetUrl.includes("kbs")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "http://d.kbs.co.kr/";
  } else if (targetUrl.includes("hrfco.go.kr")) {
    reqHeaders["Referer"] = "https://hrfco.go.kr/";
    reqHeaders["Origin"] = "https://hrfco.go.kr";
  }

  // Cloudflare Edge Cache check untuk media chunks (.ts) SEBELUM fetch ke Korea
  if (targetUrl.includes(".ts")) {
    const cache = caches.default;
    const cacheKey = new Request(url.toString(), request);
    const cached = await cache.match(cacheKey);
    if (cached) return cached;
  }

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: reqHeaders,
      redirect: "follow"
    });

    const contentType = resp.headers.get("content-type") || "";
    const isM3u8 = targetUrl.includes(".m3u8") || contentType.includes("mpegurl") || contentType.includes("application/x-mpegURL");

    if (isM3u8 && resp.ok) {
      const text = await resp.text();
      const baseUrl = targetUrl.substring(0, targetUrl.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
      const lines = text.split("\n");
      const rewritten = lines.map(line => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) return line;
        let fullSegUrl = trimmed;
        if (!trimmed.startsWith("http://") && !trimmed.startsWith("https://")) {
          fullSegUrl = baseUrl + (trimmed.startsWith("/") ? trimmed.slice(1) : trimmed);
        }
        return "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(fullSegUrl);
      }).join("\n");

      return new Response(rewritten, {
        status: resp.status,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": contentType || "application/vnd.apple.mpegurl",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=2"
        }
      });
    }

    const isTsChunk = targetUrl.includes(".ts");
    const responseToReturn = new Response(resp.body, {
      status: resp.status,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": contentType || (isTsChunk ? "video/mp2t" : "video/mp4"),
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Cache-Control": isTsChunk ? "public, max-age=60, s-maxage=120" : "public, max-age=10"
      }
    });
    if (isTsChunk && resp.ok) {
      const cache = caches.default;
      const cacheKey = new Request(url.toString(), request);
      ctx.waitUntil(cache.put(cacheKey, responseToReturn.clone()));
    }
    return responseToReturn;
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response("Proxy error: " + err.message, { status: 502 });
  }
}

async function handleZ3Resolve(request, url) {
  const key = url.searchParams.get("key") || "";
  const query = url.searchParams.get("query") || "";
  const cctvip = url.searchParams.get("cctvip") || "";

  // 0. Super Fast Direct Kakao Z3 via !hls (100% Realtime Live Stream m3u8 KT ICT port 8082)
  if (key) {
    try {
      const kakaoResp = await fetch("https://map.kakao.com/api/cctvs/url/" + encodeURIComponent(key), {
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
          "Referer": "https://map.kakao.com/"
        }
      });
      if (kakaoResp.ok) {
        const data = await kakaoResp.json();
        const liveUrl = data.liveUrl || "";
        const vodUrl = data.vodUrl || "";

        // Prioritas Utama: Realtime 30FPS Live HLS Stream via !hls (Direct Native KT ICT Handshake)
        if (liveUrl) {
          try {
            const hlsResp = await fetch(liveUrl + "!hls", {
              headers: {
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
                "Referer": "https://map.kakao.com/"
              }
            });
            if (hlsResp.ok) {
              const rawM3u8 = (await hlsResp.text()).trim();
              if (rawM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
                return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                  url: rawM3u8,
                  proxyUrl: rawM3u8,
                  liveUrl: liveUrl,
                  vodUrl: vodUrl,
                  type: "hls",
                  name: (data.cctv && data.cctv.name) || ""
                }), {
                  headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                    "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=10"
                  }
                });
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("[Kakao Z3 !hls Error]", e);
          }
        }

        // Fallback ke VOD jika live stream tidak aktif
        if (vodUrl) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ 
            url: vodUrl,
            vodUrl: vodUrl,
            liveUrl: liveUrl,
            type: "video/mp4",
            proxyUrl: vodUrl,
            name: (data.cctv && data.cctv.name) || ""
          }), {
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
              "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate"
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[Kakao Z3 Resolve Error]", e);
    }
  }

  if (!query && !cctvip) { {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing query or cctvip parameter" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }

  const cacheKey = cctvip || query;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cacheKey && Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) {
    const cached = Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
    if (now - cached.timestamp < 40000) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(cached.data), {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=30",
          "X-Token-Cache": "HIT"
        }
      });
    } else {
      Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.delete(cacheKey);
    }
  }

  // 1. Direct Resolution dari Z3_MAP (Token Fresh its.go.kr)
  const appUrl = Z3_MAP[cctvip];
  if (appUrl) {
    try {
      const hlsResp = await fetch(appUrl + "!hls", {
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
          "Referer": "https://its.go.kr/"
        }
      });
      if (hlsResp.ok) {
        const liveM3u8 = (await hlsResp.text()).trim();
        if (liveM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
          const payload = {
            status: "resolved",
            cctvip: cctvip,
            streamUrl: liveM3u8,
            proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(liveM3u8)
          };
          if (cacheKey) Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.set(cacheKey, { timestamp: now, data: payload });
          return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
              "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=40",
              "X-Token-Cache": "MISS"
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Direct Z3_MAP fetch failed, falling back to JSP:", e);
    }
  }

  // 2. Fallback: Fetch latest fresh Z3 token from Oracle Chuncheon cache
  try {
    const oracleCacheResp = await fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ciroxtreme/ciro-cctv-proxy/gh-pages/z3-cache.json", {
      headers: { "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" }
    });
    if (oracleCacheResp.ok) {
      const oracleJson = await oracleCacheResp.json();
      const freshAppUrl = oracleJson.data && oracleJson.data[cctvip];
      if (freshAppUrl) {
        const hlsResp2 = await fetch(freshAppUrl + "!hls", {
          headers: {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
            "Referer": "https://its.go.kr/"
          }
        });
        if (hlsResp2.ok) {
          const liveM3u8_2 = (await hlsResp2.text()).trim();
          if (liveM3u8_2.startsWith("http")) {
            const payload = {
              status: "resolved",
              cctvip: cctvip,
              streamUrl: liveM3u8_2,
              proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(liveM3u8_2)
            };
            if (cacheKey) Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.set(cacheKey, { timestamp: now, data: payload });
            return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=40",
                "X-Token-Cache": "ORACLE-CACHE-HIT"
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (errOracle) {
    console.warn("Oracle z3-cache fetch failed:", errOracle);
  }

  // 3. Fallback UTIC JSP wrapper URL
  const targetJsp = "https://www.utic.go.kr/jsp/map/openDataCctvStream.jsp?" + (query || `kind=Z3&cctvip=${cctvip}`);
  const upstreamProxy = "https://ciro-cctv-proxy.fly.dev/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(targetJsp);

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(upstreamProxy, {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
      }
    });

    if (!resp.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: `Upstream gateway error ${resp.status}` }), {
        status: 502,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const html = await resp.text();
    // Extract video_url assigned by the JSP script
    const match = html.match(/video_url\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/);
    if (!match) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Live session token not found in stream wrapper" }), {
        status: 404,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const streamTokenUrl = match[1];
    const payload = {
      status: "resolved",
      cctvip: cctvip,
      streamUrl: streamTokenUrl,
      proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(streamTokenUrl)
    };
    if (cacheKey) Z3_TOKEN_CACHE.set(cacheKey, { timestamp: now, data: payload });
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=40",
        "X-Token-Cache": "MISS"
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }
}
}

function handleHtml(url) {
  const html = renderKoreaHtml(VERIFIED_CAMS.length);
  return new Response(html, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=60"
    }
  });
}


async function handleGitsResolve(request, url) {
  const cctvid = (url.searchParams.get("cctvid") || url.searchParams.get("id") || "").replace("GITS_", "").trim();
  if (!cctvid) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing cctvid" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  if (GITS_TOKEN_CACHE.has(cctvid)) {
    const cached = GITS_TOKEN_CACHE.get(cctvid);
    if (now - cached.timestamp < 45000) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(cached.data), {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=30",
          "X-Token-Cache": "HIT"
        }
      });
    } else {
      GITS_TOKEN_CACHE.delete(cctvid);
    }
  }

  const popupUrl = `https://gits.gg.go.kr/web/popup/webCctvPopup.do?cctvId=${cctvid}`;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(popupUrl, {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
        "Referer": "https://gits.gg.go.kr/web/map/webMap.do?opt=3"
      }
    });

    if (!resp.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: `GITS Gateway ${resp.status}` }), {
        status: 502,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const html = await resp.text();
    let streamUrl = "";
    let type = "hls";

    // 1. Prioritaskan jalur !hls (Realtime Live Stream m3u8 KT ICT tanpa batas 30 detik)
    const mHls = html.match(/["'](https?:)?(\/\/gitsview\.gg\.go\.kr\/[^"']+!hls)["']/i);
    if (mHls) {
      try {
        const hlsEndpoint = "https:" + mHls[2];
        const hlsResp = await fetch(hlsEndpoint, {
          headers: {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
            "Referer": "https://gits.gg.go.kr/"
          }
        });
        if (hlsResp.ok) {
          const rawM3u8 = (await hlsResp.text()).trim();
          if (rawM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
            streamUrl = rawM3u8;
            type = "hls";
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("GITS !hls endpoint fetch failed, falling back to MP4:", e);
      }
    }

    // 2. Fallback jika !hls gagal: Gunakan direct videoUrl / mVid
    if (!streamUrl) {
      const mUrl = html.match(/var\s+videoUrl\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']/i);
      const mVid = html.match(/<video[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/i);
      if (mUrl) {
        streamUrl = mUrl[1];
        type = streamUrl.includes(".m3u8") ? "hls" : "mp4";
      } else if (mVid) {
        streamUrl = mVid[1];
        type = streamUrl.includes(".m3u8") ? "hls" : "mp4";
      }
    }

    if (!streamUrl) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "GITS stream session not found" }), {
        status: 404,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    if (streamUrl.startsWith("//")) streamUrl = "https:" + streamUrl;
    if (streamUrl.startsWith("http://")) streamUrl = streamUrl.replace("http://", "https://");

    const payload = {
      status: "resolved",
      cctvid: cctvid,
      type: type,
      streamUrl: streamUrl,
      proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(streamUrl)
    };
    GITS_TOKEN_CACHE.set(cctvid, { timestamp: now, data: payload });

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=45",
        "X-Token-Cache": "MISS"
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }
}

async function handleIncheonResolve(request, url) {
  const cctvid = (url.searchParams.get("cctvid") || url.searchParams.get("id") || "").replace("INCHEON_", "").trim();
  const rawUrl = url.searchParams.get("url") || "";

  let target = rawUrl;
  if (!target && cctvid) {
    target = `https://61.40.94.13/cctv/L${cctvid}.stream/playlist.m3u8`;
  } else if (target.startsWith("http://61.40.94.13:1935/")) {
    target = target.replace("http://61.40.94.13:1935/", "https://61.40.94.13/");
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({
    status: "resolved",
    cctvid: cctvid,
    type: "hls",
    streamUrl: target,
    directHttpsUrl: target,
    note: "Served directly over HTTPS port 443 without mixed content error"
  }), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=600"
    }
  });
}

async function handleKbsResolve(request, url) {
  const cctvid = (url.searchParams.get("cctvid") || url.searchParams.get("id") || "").replace("KBS_", "").trim();
  if (!cctvid) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing cctvid parameter" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  if (KBS_TOKEN_CACHE.has(cctvid)) {
    const cached = KBS_TOKEN_CACHE.get(cctvid);
    if (now - cached.timestamp < 60000) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(cached.data), {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=60",
          "X-Token-Cache": "HIT"
        }
      });
    } else {
      KBS_TOKEN_CACHE.delete(cctvid);
    }
  }

  try {
    const popupUrl = `http://d.kbs.co.kr/special/cctv/cctvPopup?type=LIVE&cctvId=${cctvid}`;
    const popupResp = await fetch(popupUrl, {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
        "Referer": "http://d.kbs.co.kr/special/cctv",
        "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
      }
    });

    if (!popupResp.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: `KBS Gateway ${popupResp.status}` }), {
        status: 502,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const html = await popupResp.text();
    const m = html.match(/id="url"\s+value="([^"]+)"/i);
    if (!m) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "KBS stream URL not found" }), {
        status: 404,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const hlsApi = m[1];
    const hlsResp = await fetch(hlsApi, {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
        "Referer": "http://d.kbs.co.kr/"
      }
    });

    if (!hlsResp.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: `Loomex Gateway ${hlsResp.status}` }), {
        status: 502,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
      });
    }

    const liveM3u8 = (await hlsResp.text()).trim();
    const payload = {
      status: "resolved",
      cctvid: cctvid,
      type: "hls",
      streamUrl: liveM3u8,
      proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(liveM3u8)
    };
    KBS_TOKEN_CACHE.set(cctvid, { timestamp: now, data: payload });

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=60",
        "X-Token-Cache": "MISS"
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }
}


// Handler Jeju Resolver
async function handleJejuResolve(request, url) {
  const key = url.searchParams.get("key") || "";
  const uuid = url.searchParams.get("uuid") || "";
  const id = url.searchParams.get("id") || "";

  if (key) {
    try {
      const kakaoResp = await fetch("https://map.kakao.com/api/cctvs/url/" + encodeURIComponent(key), {
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
          "Referer": "https://map.kakao.com/"
        }
      });
      if (kakaoResp.ok) {
        const data = await kakaoResp.json();
        const liveUrl = data.liveUrl || "";
        const vodUrl = data.vodUrl || "";

        // Prioritas Utama: Realtime 30FPS Live HLS Stream via !hls (Direct Native KT ICT Handshake)
        if (liveUrl) {
          try {
            const hlsResp = await fetch(liveUrl + "!hls", {
              headers: {
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
                "Referer": "https://map.kakao.com/"
              }
            });
            if (hlsResp.ok) {
              const rawM3u8 = (await hlsResp.text()).trim();
              if (rawM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
                return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                  url: rawM3u8,
                  proxyUrl: rawM3u8,
                  liveUrl: liveUrl,
                  vodUrl: vodUrl,
                  type: "hls",
                  name: (data.cctv && data.cctv.name) || ""
                }), {
                  headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                    "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=10"
                  }
                });
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("[Kakao Jeju !hls Error]", e);
          }
        }

        // Fallback ke VOD jika live stream tidak aktif
        if (vodUrl) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ 
            url: vodUrl,
            vodUrl: vodUrl,
            liveUrl: liveUrl,
            type: "video/mp4",
            proxyUrl: vodUrl,
            name: (data.cctv && data.cctv.name) || ""
          }), {
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
              "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate"
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[Jeju Kakao Resolve Error]", e);
    }

    // Jalur Satelit Cadangan 2: Naver Map KT ICT Resolver
    try {
      const naverResp = await fetch("https://map.naver.com/p/api/cctv?cctvId=" + encodeURIComponent(key), {
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
          "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/p",
          "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*"
        }
      });
      if (naverResp.ok) {
        const nData = await naverResp.json();
        const nList = nData.message && nData.message.result && nData.message.result.cctvList;
        if (nList && nList.length > 0) {
          const match = nList.find(c => String(c.channel) === String(key)) || nList[0];
          const hlsUrl = match.hlsUrl || "";
          if (hlsUrl) {
            const ktResp = await fetch(hlsUrl, {
              headers: {
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
                "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/"
              },
              redirect: "manual"
            });
            const location = ktResp.headers.get("Location");
            const targetM3u8 = location || hlsUrl;
            if (targetM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
              return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                url: targetM3u8,
                proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(targetM3u8),
                type: "hls",
                name: match.cctvStrtSecnNm || match.cctvNm || ""
              }), {
                headers: {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=15"
                }
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (ne) {
      console.error("[Jeju Naver Resolve Error]", ne);
    }
  }

  if (!uuid && !id && !key) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing key, id or uuid" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ 
    error: "Jeju traffic stream is currently connecting via regional relay",
    uuid: uuid,
    id: id
  }), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
    }
  });
}

async function handleNaverResolve(request, url) {
  const key = url.searchParams.get("key") || "";
  if (!key) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing key" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
    });
  }

  try {
    const naverResp = await fetch("https://map.naver.com/p/api/cctv?cctvId=" + encodeURIComponent(key), {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
        "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/p",
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*"
      }
    });

    if (naverResp.ok) {
      const nData = await naverResp.json();
      const nList = nData.message && nData.message.result && nData.message.result.cctvList;
      if (nList && nList.length > 0) {
        const match = nList.find(c => String(c.channel) === String(key)) || nList[0];
        const hlsUrl = match.hlsUrl || "";
        if (hlsUrl) {
          const ktResp = await fetch(hlsUrl, {
            headers: {
              "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
              "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/"
            },
            redirect: "manual"
          });
          const location = ktResp.headers.get("Location");
          const targetM3u8 = location || hlsUrl;
          if (targetM3u8.startsWith("http")) {
            return new Response(JSON.stringify({
              url: targetM3u8,
              proxyUrl: "/proxy?url=" + encodeURIComponent(targetM3u8),
              type: "hls",
              name: match.cctvStrtSecnNm || match.cctvNm || ""
            }), {
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=15"
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[Naver Resolve Error]", err);
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Naver stream resolve failed", key: key }), {
    status: 502,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" }
  });
}
